answer: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days and express shipping takes 1–2 business days. To check a specific order, please share your order number with a support agent.
Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. A support agent can help with damaged items or return labels.
We never ask for full card numbers in chat. For billing questions, use the secure account portal or ask to be connected with a support agent.
Use the “Forgot password” option on the sign-in page to reset your password. For account-access issues, a support agent can verify your account through approved channels.
